title: Tine & Tide Rhodes
description: A warm FM-tine Rhodes chord pad rooted in C major / A minor, evoking lazy afternoon beach sessions. The FM index drifts on an 11-cycle sine while harmonicity steps every 4 bars, the lowpass filter breathes on a 13-cycle LFO, tremolo depth pulses on a 17-cycle sine, and slow panning on a 24-cycle sine — mutually-prime clocks that keep the loop alive for a full 32-cycle arc before realigning.
